baseline_process.note: PID records describe this launch, not a guarantee that the process remains alive

training.data: existing VisDrone development train/val split; not new ground-road data
training.initialization: independent output, original full optimizer/scaler/RNG and 40-epoch schedule continuation
start_gates: new current-source GPU AMP resume equivalence proof

evaluation_after_five.comparison: same dataset, truth, ignore regions, preprocessing and fixed postprocessing as the archived epoch7 baseline
evaluation_after_five.continuation_gate: in both sets, person AP50 improvement at least 1 percentage point and vehicle AP50 change at least -1 percentage point
evaluation_after_five.gate_scope: predeclared development heuristic, not statistical significance or formal acceptance
evaluation_after_five.continue_to_additional_10_15_20: only after completed comparison evidence; no unconditional continuation
evaluation_after_five.teacher: same-set evaluation before any separate distillation experiment; predictions do not replace truth

sparse_ground_scene_policy.purpose: future training supplement and explicitly bounded demonstration
sparse_ground_scene_policy.selection: predeclare camera family, scene and target-density rules before scoring; keep scene-isolated holdout
sparse_ground_scene_policy.forbidden_claim: a selected demonstration clip with 100 percent observed recall proves neither universal recall nor formal acceptance
sparse_ground_scene_policy.intersection_flow: excluded from this training due to unresolved label and split contract, not merely its target count
